design.summary: Confirmed missing Windows system-proxy discovery in both the CMD bootstrap and native source-build path. Docker CLI plugins require their own process proxy environment; a successful docker pull does not validate Buildx token requests. BuildKit container environment and Dockerfile build arguments are additional scopes, not substitutes for the host CLI environment. Preserve explicit variables; fill manual system settings only when appropriate; preserve bypass rules and explain PAC/unreachable-proxy behavior. Ensure both build phases receive settings, and avoid copying host loopback URLs directly into container settings. Existing owned persistent builders need proxy-change handling if their environment is updated. First-build support must work before the new EXE exists, and retain the PowerShell-free runtime requirement. Selected fix targets the host Buildx process environment only, matching the reporter-established workaround. Existing BuildKit container env/cache is deliberately unchanged, with separate container-network guidance.
